summary: Real failures come back as zeros, so the Probe error path never triggers on Windows; CPU, memory and disk faults show fabricated 0% readings
evidence: windows/mod.rs:39 System::new and :65 Disks::new return Ok on Windows; sysinfo cpu.rs:247-249 keeps default percent; system.rs:171 ignores GlobalMemoryStatusEx result; disk.rs:283-301 zero on failure
failure_scenario: Corrupted performance-counter registry: CPU shows 0% on every poll with no probe error.
